target: strictly positive adjusted close-to-close return over 30 positive-volume vendor observations, after origin close

inspected_inventory.2010-2017: previous training/validation; reused development, no independence claim
inspected_inventory.2019-2020: spent original evaluation; excluded from training/selection/calibration labels
inspected_inventory.2021-2023: previous inspected follow-up calibration; reused calibration, no fresh test claim

preprocessing: training-only median, population scale, clipping standardized features at +/-5; no imputation of missing raw prices or peer rows
purge: training target_end strictly before validation origin-year; validation target_end within year; calibration targets fully inside calibration window
embargo: no additional embargo: strictly matured labels; 30-row nonoverlap scoring; remaining time dependence handled descriptively by shared-quarter blocks

selection.rule: candidate must beat every declared appropriate baseline by paired shared-quarter upper loss bound below zero at Bonferroni-adjusted level across 3 candidates x 3 baselines, and beat the best baseline in at least 3/4 years; else best baseline

uncertainty.update: development OOF residuals only after target_end < next origin; no outcome refitting of point model; no method selection on 2021-2023 calibration

admission.reason: No confirmatory holdout in this development study. Independent complete data/rights review and a separately registered fresh prospective study are mandatory. Development selection alone never authorizes deployment.

limitations: Known vendor calendar and adjustment defects remain; no exchange-complete session claim
Five convenience survivors; equal-weight peer basket is not an index; only TCS/INFY have a sector peer
No new horizon, security, P&L or portfolio-effectiveness target
Final point model is deliberately stale (2017); calibration is 2021-2023. Snapshot is research only, not a current market forecast
